`OrderFacade.cancel` now throws for a CONFIRMED order and leaves its status unchanged. The full test suite passes.

The change is in `OrderService.cancel`: it loads the order, and if the status is `CONFIRMED` it throws `ShopProblem("order-not-cancellable", …)` before touching the status. Other statuses cancel as before.

I first threw `IllegalStateException`, but the `adr0011_domainFailuresAreShopProblems` architecture rule rejects that outside `Money` and `OrderReturns`. The ADR requires `platform.ShopProblem` with a stable code, so I used that. I did not add a new exemption to the architecture test.

I did not add a test for the new behaviour; the existing suite only covers cancelling a PLACED order.
